rights.notes: Rights unverified. A personal self-introduction; reuse the bloom-from-a-letter, 1 s stat-card grid and pre-hit dip principles only; never reproduce the person's identity or data.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session F) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), transitions strips at all 7 boundaries (every 2nd frame), the audio panel, the listen sheet (3 phrases, 11 accent hits); 30 fps strips at 2.60-4.20 s (a headline build, 4 word arrivals measured) and 5.40-6.30 s (a wipe and a counter). Signal features and Windows en-US dictation; nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 15.08 s (1280x720, 59.94 fps); all boundaries at 2-frame steps; two passages at 30 fps (+/- 17 ms).

concept.observed: A personal introduction for recruiters: name, a portrait and a one-line promise, four proof numbers, a map of hiring data, a set of skill cards, and a contact card.
concept.interpreted: A CV as a 15 s reel: the claim, then four numbers, then a way to get in touch.

communication_style.observed: Music only; the copy is short headlines and big numerals; one word per headline in an orange italic serif.

palette.observed: Black (#080808, 56%), a vivid orange (#f86818, 17%), white; one light card section (7.42-8.49 s).

typography.observed: Heavy grotesque for the name and numerals; small italic serif for greetings and the accent word of each headline; tiny grey labels under numerals.

composition.observed: Name centred; then portrait left inside a rotating text ring with the headline right; numerals top-left with a figure right (dot matrix, bar chart, ring gauge, icon grid); end card centred.

motion.observed: The surname's letters light up grey -> white (1.13-1.40 s); 'complexity' assembles from scattered, rotated letters (2.77-3.17 s) and the accent word writes on in the orange serif (3.27-3.53 s), then an underline (3.6 s); counters roll (1 -> 14 in 0.36 s, 5.47-5.83 s, while 13 bars grow 5.6-6.3 s); map particle clusters with three ticking counters (9.4-11.1 s); white skill cards tumble in from the top and settle (11.70-12.04 s).

transitions.observed: 1.94 s grow: the orange O of the name grows into a full orange frame in 0.23 s (1.78-2.01 s). 5.41, 6.41, 7.41 s cover: a single hard diagonal edge sweeps across in about 0.07 s, swapping dark and orange or light cards (5.38-5.45 s). 8.49 s cut from the light card to a dark map. 11.86 s: cards fall into an empty frame. 12.95 s cover: orange stepped bars rise from the bottom (12.79-12.99 s) onto the end card.
transitions.interpreted: The opening bloom comes out of the name itself; the stat cards change on a 1 s grid like slides.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Name 1.9 s, promise about 2.6 s, four stat cards of about 0.9, 1.00, 1.00 and 1.08 s (about 4.5-8.49 s, the middle changes exactly 1.00 s apart), map 3.2 s, cards 1.3 s, contact 2.1 s.

sound_design.observed: -14.6 LUFS, LRA 5.2 LU, true peak -1.6 dBTP; tempo 123 bpm (low confidence); 51 onsets; 11 accents (43.8/min). Accents on boundaries 1 of 7 (0.14, chance 0.14): only the cut to the map, +98 ms (8.49 -> 8.59 s). Onsets within 50 ms of boundaries 0.57 (chance 0.29), median 46 ms: the three diagonal wipes each follow an onset by 45-47 ms (5.36, 6.36, 7.36 s), so the stat cards change on the beat. Strongest accents: the surname letters lighting (1.23, 1.30 s), the accent-word underline (3.60 s), the cut to the map (8.59 s), map counters ticking on a 0.49 s grid (9.61, 10.10, 10.59 s), cards landing (12.61 s). Pre-hit dip: the level falls to -39.6 dB (film median -17.2 dB) from 1.07 to 2.00 s while the name holds and its O starts to grow; the body enters at 2.09-2.28 s (-10.3 dB) as the orange fills the frame. Head -15.7 dB (the dip), tail -5.6 dB. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Silence after the name makes the orange bloom the film's first downbeat.

narration.observed: None, although the title suggested a voice. Dictation: 14 raw words, 6 confident, 3 phrases (1.29-3.16, 6.33-9.71, 12.59-15.05 s); 0.78 words/s while 'speaking', 26 words/min over the span, 2 pauses (median 3025 ms, max 3170 ms), thirds 0.44/0.65/0.22 words/s, cuts in pauses 0.29 (chance 0.44), next phrase 826 ms after a cut. The phrase frames show the name, the portrait headline, stat cards, the map, the skill cards and the end card, and no one speaking; three of the six confident 'words' are the same single letter; the spectrogram shows steady music harmonics without speech formants; syllabic share 0.33 (corpus median 0.34).
narration.interpreted: Recogniser noise over music: these numbers are not a narration pace.

captions.observed: No captions. Copy lanes: the name centred; headlines left-aligned beside the portrait or under a numeral (2-3 lines of 1-3 words); big numerals top-left with a two-line grey label; centred end card. One accent word per headline in an orange italic serif. Headline words against onsets (2.60-3.27 s): 0 to -70 ms (median -40 ms), 2 of 4 within 50 ms against chance 0.38: not a lock.
captions.interpreted: The accent word is the payoff of each line, the way a highlight works in a caption.

scenes.observed: A line draws; greeting and name; the surname lights up.
Orange bloom; portrait in a text ring; the promise headline builds.
Four stat cards on a 1 s grid, swapped by diagonal edges.
Dark map with particle clusters and three ticking counters.
Skill cards tumble in; one line about the work.

moments.observed: The orange O of the name grows to fill the frame in 0.23 s (1.78-2.01 s), right after a 0.9 s dip in the sound.
moments.interpreted: The brand colour is born from the name itself.

difficult: The map's particle clusters (thousands of dots) are heavy as DOM; Canvas 2D or a pre-rendered plate
uncertainties: Whether the dip at 1.07-2.00 s is a deliberate dropout or the music's own intro
